interpretation: All current 37 common NAV methods passed on WasmJS, browser JS and desktop. The 14 desktop-only methods also passed. The 125 target executions reuse 51 source methods and are not 125 unique tests.
Original FloatArray regression, both bit-sensitive signed-zero scalar/array regressions, and both actual runtime U+D800 input preconditions/rejection methods passed on all three targets.

The desktop invocation compiled current NAV tests and freshly executed the full NAV 51-case subset, removing the previous pending-desktop-fixture gap. It also passed all 11 real Compose host tests, including registry/full-map Java-byte/dispose/recreate restoration, plus 3 narrow JVM compatibility fixtures.

Browser004 production/test compilation and executable link tasks were UP-TO-DATE; fresh browser runtime tasks and matching fresh generated configurations were independently inspected. Desktop production was UP-TO-DATE and test compilation executed.
Every run's selected 693-input before/after maps matched. All 32 NAV inputs were independently matched to current bytes, each other and the runtime-surrogate fixture refreeze.
The complete browser commands report 290 passes each and scoped desktop command 73; this reviewer independently recounted only NAV's 37,37,51. Other area counts are attributed to the lead archives.

Preserve all earlier failed runs and source/diagnostic checkpoints. Current successful regressions do not retroactively alter those outcomes or prove a precise compiler/cache cause for the earlier emitted-surrogate corruption.
limitations: No unchanged-source pass is a new unique test; prior JS003/desktop repeats are not added to these source-method counts.

Browser configs attest selected paths/fields and observed tooling, not the entire resolved graph, later executable plugin configuration or every process byte. No dependency/provenance/closure gate is promoted.
Wasm loader, magic/version and binary hash were inspected, not instruction-level disassembly. Executed source-bound methods and explicit input assertions are the runtime evidence.

Xvfb desktop host restoration is not Android Bundle or physical process-death verification. Latest Android/device, Apple KLIB/link/simulator/device and minimum-runtime checks remain separate; the two iOS-only methods are not executed here.

No claims are added for UIKit/browser-native navigation parity, font/platform accessibility, exact upstream-copy provenance, packaged notices/legal clearance, full ABI, Maven consumers or release readiness.
No status promotion, issue closure, remote operation, commit, package, release or Pages change is authorized by these results.
